name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
There is evil lurking here along the coast, friend.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.

Return to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.
narrative.offerRewardText: We could use more of your kind around here, adventurer. Thank you for your help.
narrative.requestItemsText: The naga increase in numbers, adventurer. Please complete this task for me.
